items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: And Ben Webster came in and he said to me, "Come go with me, I want you to hear this saxophone player."

ctx.x: The first time I heard it, I would say,

I was in the Army, and I visited 52nd Street, you know, one of my nights, you know, out. And Ben Webster was playing at one of the clubs. I don't remember which one it was. On 52nd Street. And I was around the corner in a bar, a bar where everybody, all the musicians, used to congregate, you know, drinking and conversation and what not. And Ben Webster came in and he said to me, "Come go with me, I want you to hear this saxophone player." "He's playing right now around the corner," and he took me around the…
So you heard the master from the beginning.
